column1: # Curated, theme-tagged wallpaper catalog — used by `rice wallpapers` / `rice get-wallpaper`.
# Format:  scheme <TAB> name <TAB> url      (lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored)
# Every URL is a direct raw.githubusercontent.com blob, downloadable with `curl -L`.
# All links verified live when shipped. `scheme` matches palette.conf's scheme key; `any` entries
# are theme-agnostic dark wallpapers offered alongside every dark scheme.
